newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOCCER-FANS RIOT AFTER LOCK OUT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FANS RIOT AFTER LOCK OUT.

text.p: Fans rioted outside a Brazilian soccer stadium after they were locked out of a match even though they had tickets, police said on Friday.
Around 2,500 Corinthians supporters were prevented from entering the Brinco de Ouro da Princesa stadium in the city of Campinas to watch their team's match at Guarani on Thursday night.
On being refused entry, they threw stones at parked vehicles, attempted to force down the gates and fought with riot police, said a police source in Campinas,..
Police said the gates were shut because the part of the stadium allocated to the Corinthians fans was full, although during the game empty spaces were visible on the terraces.
Around two dozen police suffered minor wounds, mostly the result of being hit by stones, the source said.
News reports said one man died of a heart attack but the police source said he was not one of the fans who had been trying to enter the stadium and had not been involved in the trouble.
The fans were dispersed by police before the game had ended, the source said.
There was also trouble on the pitch with both teams having one player sent off.
Corinthians won 1-0 to become the first team to make sure of a place in the four-team final stage of the Sao Paulo championship.
